reviews.t: I did not really feel like it changed my skin that drastically or even at ...
reviews.x: I have acne prone, sensitive, and combination skin and this cleanser was only okay. I did not really feel like it changed my skin that drastically or even at all. I let my friend try it and there was no difference for him either. So overall I feel like this cleanser is kind of overrated. And since this product was selling well I saw that the price was even raised by a lot which I wasn't happy about. I don't think I'll be repurchasing since it didn't help me.

I purchased this because lately all my cleansers have left my face feeling tight and stripped so this was recommended to me. I will start off by saying that it absolutely did not leave that feeling for me so that’s a plus. But when I did apply it, a blemish on my skin started burning like crazy, I don’t know if it was because my blemish was super irritated or what, but I’m kinda scared to use this again and am back at square one with no idea what to do.

reviews.t: Great cleanser for most skin types
reviews.x: This has been my go to cleanser for YEARS. I have dry, sensitive skin and find that this cleanser is gentle enough for daily use. It doesn't foam up like normal sulphate based cleansers but cleans your skin nonetheless, and the gentle acid provides the perfect amount of exfoliation. I'm personally very sensitive to many acids but this cleanser is definitely gentle enough for me. Its also the go to cleanser for my boyfriend who has oily skin!

I absolutely love this cleanser ... so I’m on round three of buying this cleanser ... I have relatively oily skin with large pores .. prone to breakouts.  I usually use / need something strong to keep acne at bay ... however most cleansers I’ve bought in the past dry out my skin.  This is well balanced and the smell is addictive.  Keeps my skin subtle, oil production has improved and my skin looks hydrated

I have been using this for years and hope it's never discontinued! Lathers well, has a lovely faint clean fragrance, and leaves my face feeling soft. reviews.t: This is the perfect followup to any cleanser and keeps my skin balanced

claims.text: Many reviewers find it gentle and effective for their skin, including oily, combination, and acne-prone types.
Several reviewers say it cleanses well without leaving skin dry, stripped, or with a squeaky-clean feel.
Some reviewers report receiving counterfeit or fake products with different smell or packaging.
A few reviewers report skin reactions such as breakouts or itchy bumps.
Reviewers appreciate the scent and value, and some use it as part of a double-cleansing routine.
